sources.title: Official exact SKU/options and manufacturer product description

limitations: Official ETH guide identifies Factory_Testing.bin as onboard test firmware at0x0; recovered text does not explicitly establish preloaded factory identity. Kept as official project trial, not reclassified as factory.
Partial source-bounded digital simulation. Physical hardware, complete original factory applications and browser/WebGL acceptance are not claimed.
ETH memory16F8P; one GPIO21 GRB WS2812; actual SPI SD7/6/5/4. W5500 network and OV5640 SCCB/DVP unimplemented; only exact GPIO reset/enable and SPI observation.
Original generic RGB demo declares60strip pixels, but exact schematic has one WS2812; no invented60LED board chain.
No hardware-fit or browser/WebGL acceptance is implied by the retained CAD or CPU geometry checks.
Factory display execution is independently recorded in product limitations; a model screen only shows the actual emulator framebuffer.
No board-level layout/CAD is supplied by the inspected exact-family sources. Photo-visible component envelopes remain approximate; unknown PCB surfaces are explicitly marked UNKNOWN.
Assembly groups preserve soldered or fixed components with their carrier; kit contents without a documented mounted pose use an explicitly staged inspection layout, not a physical installation claim.
USB-C and TF are on the opposite PCB face from W5500/RJ45/ESP32. The unknown back face is not replaced by a mirrored front photograph.
Exact -M variants add2x20 soldered headers; loose headers are not shown on bare variants. Pin length and socket/plug tolerances are uncalibrated.
PoE carrier and OV5640 assemblies only appear in included kit variants. Their hidden circuitry, cable routing and precise stack dimensions remain UNKNOWN.

chronology.notes: 硬件发布日期未知；没有把资料/固件日期当作发布时间。
